<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/cases/{caseId}/trees/{versionId}/activations/{importId}/report"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the worker report of an activation: counts of valid, retired and missing record labels, successor rewrites, codes without a successor, and memo entries whose scope names categories that are not valid in the version. importId is the id of the activation in GET /cases/\{caseId\}/records/imports, matched by the jobGuid returned when it was accepted.
